Check whether a number is prime by counting its factors.

Supplied answer
def is_prime(n):
    count = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if n % i == 0:
            count += 1
    return count == 2 # exactly 1 and itself
print(is_prime(3)) # True
print(is_prime(4)) # False
Note: A prime number has exactly two factors. 1 has only one factor, so 1 is not prime.
